title: Breadcrumbing Search Agents
title_zh: Breadcrumbing Search Agents：面向搜索智能体的“面包屑式”长程攻击
abstract_en: LLM-based search agents are widely used for information-seeking tasks, but their reliance on external tool returns introduces a critical security risk: web content retrieved during execution is untrusted, exposing agents to prompt injection and goal hijacking. Prior work on search-agent safety primarily focuses on static web-content injection, but modern agents issue follow-up queries and cross-check competing sources, so a single injected page is often diluted or rejected. We show that the channel delivering search and page observations is a fragile security boundary: beyond exposing the agent to a single poisoned page, a mediated search interface can repeatedly steer how the agent gathers evidence and forms its final answer. Under a constrained tool-intermediary threat model, appending only one controlled result per query can substantially increase attack success when the evidence is coordinated across the agent's trajectory. We study this setting with a strategy-driven long-horizon attack system and introduce Authority-Chain Hijack (ACH), an expert-refined strategy that turns isolated search-result and page-content manipulations into a coherent evidence chain across seemingly corroborating sources. ACH achieves the highest Overall ASR among all baselines, reaching 55.9% / 83.3% ASR / MaxN ASR on the full SafeSearch test split. We further introduce Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution (TGSE), which automatically improves attacker strategies from execution traces, replacing manual redesign with trace-driven refinement; its strongest single setting reaches 71.4% / 95.0% in held-out evaluation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究 LLM-based search agents 在信息检索任务中的安全风险。由于搜索智能体依赖外部搜索结果和网页内容作为观察输入，而这些内容本质上不可信，因此容易受到 prompt injection 与目标劫持攻击。不同于以往主要关注单个网页静态注入的工作，本文指出现代搜索智能体会进行多轮查询、追问和交叉验证，单个被污染页面往往会被稀释或拒绝。作者提出，搜索与页面观察通道本身是脆弱的安全边界：在受限的 tool-intermediary threat model 下，攻击者即使每次查询只追加一个受控结果，也能通过跨轨迹协调证据显著提升攻击成功率。论文提出 Authority-Chain Hijack（ACH），将搜索结果操控与页面内容操控组织成看似相互印证的证据链，在 SafeSearch 完整测试集上达到最高 Overall ASR，取得 55.9% ASR / 83.3% MaxN ASR。此外，论文提出 Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution（TGSE），可基于执行轨迹自动优化攻击策略，在 held-out evaluation 中最强单设置达到 71.4% ASR / 95.0% MaxN ASR。
key_points_zh: 指出搜索智能体的工具观察通道是脆弱安全边界：攻击不必依赖单个恶意网页，而可在多轮搜索中持续引导证据收集与最终回答。
提出受限 tool-intermediary threat model：攻击者每次查询仅能追加一个受控搜索结果，但可跨查询协调搜索结果与页面内容。
提出 Authority-Chain Hijack（ACH），通过构造看似来自多个权威来源的连贯证据链，实现长程目标劫持。
ACH 在 SafeSearch 完整测试集上达到 55.9% ASR / 83.3% MaxN ASR，优于所有基线攻击策略。
提出 Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution（TGSE），利用执行轨迹自动迭代攻击策略，在 held-out evaluation 中达到 71.4% ASR / 95.0% MaxN ASR。

llm_assessment.comment: This is strong agent-security work because it studies trajectory-level search manipulation and trace-guided adversarial strategy evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇很强的智能体安全论文，研究了轨迹级搜索操控和基于执行轨迹的攻击策略演化。
